candidates.video_title: Gemini Moon Is Making Everyone Overthink Right Now
candidates.video_description: The Waning Gibbous Moon in Gemini on October 1st is flooding your mind with information, options, and conflicting thoughts. Here's what astrology says about navigating it.
candidates.script: Your brain hasn't stopped running in three days — and there's a reason for that. The Moon is in Gemini right now, Waning Gibbous phase, and in astrology this placement floods your nervous system with input, options, and half-finished thoughts. Gemini moons are traditionally linked to communication overload — the mind absorbs everything but struggles to settle. The waning phase adds a release pressure. Astrologers say this is less about deciding and more about letting the noise die down first. Which sign are you?

candidates.topic: Mercury in Scorpio — Secrets and Sharp Words

candidates.video_description: Mercury is now at 1.7° Scorpio, and in astrology this placement transforms how we think, speak, and listen. Expect deeper conversations and hidden truths surfacing.
candidates.script: Mercury in Scorpio doesn't do small talk — it goes straight for the truth, even when the truth is uncomfortable. Right now Mercury sits at 1° Scorpio, and in astrology this is considered one of the sharpest, most psychologically penetrating placements Mercury can occupy. Traditional astrology links it to uncovering secrets, reading between the lines, and conversations that cut deep. Words carry more weight here. What you say — and what you leave unsaid — lands differently. Watch your language this month. It remembers everything.

candidates.topic: Four Planets Retrograde — The Outer Slowdown Explained
candidates.teaser: Four planets are retrograde right now — but one of them is about to shake things up in a way most people aren't ready for.
candidates.video_title: 4 Planets Retrograde Right Now — One Changes Everything
candidates.video_description: Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto are all retrograde as of October 1st, 2026. In astrology, this level of outer planet retrograde activity signals a collective turning inward — but not all of them work the same way.
candidates.script: Four planets are retrograde right now — Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto — and most people are feeling it without knowing why. In astrology, outer planet retrogrades aren't about missed flights or broken phones. They work slower and deeper. Saturn retrograde in Aries challenges the structures you built on other people's rules. Uranus retrograde in Gemini quietly rewires how your mind works. Neptune and Pluto pull entire illusions apart at the roots. This isn't chaos — astrologers call it compression before clarity. Which one is hitting you hardest?

candidates.topic: Rising Sign vs Sun Sign — Why Your Sun Sign Feels Wrong
candidates.teaser: If your Sun sign has never felt quite right, there's an astrological reason — and most people never find out what it is.
candidates.video_title: Why Your Zodiac Sign Feels Wrong — The Rising Sign
candidates.video_description: Millions of people identify with their Sun sign — but in astrology, the Rising sign (Ascendant) is often the stronger felt identity. Here's why the difference matters.
candidates.script: If your Sun sign has never fully felt like you, you're not wrong — and you're not broken. In astrology, the Rising sign is the lens your entire personality filters through. It's determined by the exact time you were born, not just the date, and astrologers often say it's what you actually look like from the outside — your instincts, your first reactions, the vibe you give off before you've said a single word. Your Sun sign is who you're becoming. Your Rising sign is who you already are. Do you know yours?

candidates.topic: Venus and Mercury Both in Scorpio — Rare Intensity

candidates.video_title: Venus + Mercury Both in Scorpio — This Is Rare
candidates.video_description: With Venus at 8.4° Scorpio and Mercury at 1.7° Scorpio on October 1st, 2026, both the planet of desire and the planet of communication are operating in Scorpio's intense, truth-seeking energy simultaneously.
candidates.script: Right now, both Venus and Mercury are in Scorpio — and that combination is not subtle. Venus at 8° Scorpio deepens every desire, every attachment, every craving for emotional honesty. Mercury at 1° Scorpio sharpens the mind into a scalpel. In astrology, when both the planet of love and the planet of communication occupy the same sign, that sign's energy saturates how you think and what you want simultaneously. Scorpio doesn't do surface level. Expect cravings for real conversation, real connection, real truth. Anything shallow feels unbearable right now.
